rows.one access: struct X { int a; int b; };
rows.two accesses: class X { int a; public: int b; };
rows.static member in other access: struct X { int a; private: static int s; void f(); };
rows.members in base and derived: struct B { int a; }; struct X : B { int b; };
rows.members in base only: struct B { int a; }; struct X : B { void f(); };
rows.members two bases down: struct B { int a; }; struct M : B {}; struct X : M {};
rows.empty bases, members in derived: struct E1 {}; struct E2 {}; struct X : E1, E2 { int a; };
rows.unnamed bit-field in derived: struct B { int a; }; struct X : B { int : 3; };
rows.zero-width bit-field in derived: struct B { int a; }; struct X : B { int : 0; };
rows.members in two bases: struct B1 { int a; }; struct B2 { int b; }; struct X : B1, B2 {};
rows.same empty base twice: struct E {}; struct B1 : E {}; struct B2 : E {}; struct X : B1, B2 { int a; };
rows.same empty base twice, no members: struct E {}; struct B1 : E {}; struct B2 : E {}; struct X : B1, B2 {};
rows.base type is first member type: struct E {}; struct X : E { E e; int a; };
rows.base type is second member type: struct E {}; struct X : E { int a; E e; };
rows.base type first inside first member: struct E {}; struct M { E e; int b; }; struct X : E { M m; };
rows.base type second inside first member: struct E {}; struct M { int b; E e; }; struct X : E { M m; };
rows.first member array of base type: struct E {}; struct X : E { E arr[2]; };
rows.first member union holding base type: struct E {}; union V { int i; E e; }; struct X : E { V v; };
rows.overlap member of base type, not first: struct E {}; struct X : E { int a; [[no_unique_address]] E e; };
rows.overlap member of other empty type: struct E {}; struct F {}; struct X : E { int a; [[no_unique_address]] F f; };
rows.member not standard-layout: struct M { int a; private: int b; }; struct X { M m; };
rows.base not standard-layout: struct B { int a; private: int b; }; struct X : B {};
rows.virtual function: struct X { virtual void f() {} int a; };
rows.virtual base: struct B {}; struct X : virtual B { int a; };
rows.array member: struct P { int a; }; struct X { P arr[2]; };
rows.union, two accesses: union X { int a; private: float b; };
rows.union, member not standard-layout: struct M { int a; private: int b; }; union X { M m; int i; };
rows.bit-field first: struct X { int a : 3; int b; };
rows.lambda, no capture: inline auto l = [] {}; using X = decltype(l);
rows.lambda, copy capture: inline auto l = [v = 1] { return v; }; using X = decltype(l);
rows.lambda, reference capture: inline int g; inline auto l = [&r = g] { return r; }; using X = decltype(l);
rows.const class: struct P { int a; }; using X = const P;
rows.array of non-standard-layout: struct M { int a; private: int b; }; using X = M[2];
